gloss: food delivery; home delivery of food

definitions.explanation: the service of delivering prepared food from a restaurant to a customer's location

examples.japanese: ⟦{寿司|すし}→寿司：04946_sushi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{出前|でまえ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{頼|たの}む→頼む：01104_tanomu⟧。
{出前|でまえ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{無料|むりょう}→無料：01662_muryou⟧です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。

examples.english: I often order delivery on rainy days.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{出前|でまえ}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦やっています→やる：02980_yaru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。

CULTURAL NOTE:
Traditional {出前|でまえ} in Japan often involves food being delivered on reusable dishes (like soba delivery), which are later collected. Modern delivery apps have made {出前|でまえ} more common, often using the term ⟦デリバリー→デリバリー：06181_deribarii⟧.

{出前|でまえ}{一丁|いっちょう}! is a traditional call meaning 'One delivery coming up!'
